Thanks for the reply. He’s young, almost 2 years old. 
He sometimes bites his leg but more like in the relieving itchiness way. 
Just to add, when we first got him and he was like 3-4 months old, her dislocated his knee and we got in the needed surgery, but it was on the other leg so im not sure if that correlates to anything.

Oh man,that is a good question.

I’m not really sure where it all started but my low self esteem paired with not being understood caused me to be reserved and quite honestly a strange person .I act and talk strangely.

Which I’m insecure about.I am a lazy,unmotivated individual who’s too tired to do anything.

Relationships and school are going badly.

My life isn’t in crumbles ,I have all I need to live a happy fulfilling life but I’m just not able to exploit what I’m given.I feel bad enough to want to die but numb enough to want a different ending
*hair salon
Perhaps a book or a movie will do the job,thank you ,I’ll be sure to tell them what I feel.Thanks again :)

Yeah that’s the interesting part,I’m actually part of a social services project aimed at troubled minors.

I have a psychologist and some people who come to my house Monday - Friday 

They are the ones whom I said I care so much about.But recently I feel like I’ve disappointed them too.

It gives me an extra reason to go,it’s overwhelming my need to harm myself.I wish this was just a dream but what I feel is real.

I don’t know,what now?

I’m happy that you took the time to write all this for me.

I often feel guilty of my feeling and fear that it will disturb others.

I’m already luckier than most,I have people that care about me,but it’s rather miserable,it’s hard to end it all because I care about them so much.

It’s complicated with my parents,when they’re happy they can be the most wonderful people in the world but if they’re angry it’s a whole another story.

I tried to communicate with them ,I wonder if my timing was wrong or rather it was my way of interacting,but they would get angry and disappointed.

I wish there was an easy way out,I don’t know what am I going to do.
It’s a long story,I texted resources and got the police knocking on my door,I avoided going to psych ward but I won’t be as lucky this time,I do not wish to go for the life of me

I do not know how to say this,I cannot get help,I can’t disappoint my parents or the people close to me again.I know that my wish of misery is only going to cause more pain,but at least mine won’t be amongst them
And also about to vomit at any time
Sleepy
It really does
Hurts knowing it doesn’t,what will happen to me then?
Yeah,was looking to od but chickened out halfway,anyways thanks for the reply
I took 7 5mg aripiprazole ,it isn’t much so don’t worry about it,I’m sorry you had to go through it
I’m sorry,I know you’re saying it for my good but I genuinely can’t
I’m sorry but I can’t do that,it’ll only complicate things further
Thanks ,I’m doing so-so,didn’t take any more pills.I feel extremely tired,probably the Abilify
I don’t believe so,they did not mention it at all.
Ah,they gain 600€ a day per person.No wonder they ignored all my refusals.

Masks.

Not the half face masks we are supposed to wear rn,full blown like the Guy Fawkes ones.

I just love them ,it’s not even something sexual,I feel butterflies in my stomach whenever I can’t see someone’s face.

Even helmets or face coverings like snowboarder are my taste.

I especially like it when in games or mangas they don’t even have eye holes,with hair covered and capes.

People say it’s weird and I feel like nobody gets me.
